report.scope: Fix the three code-review conditions on the uncommitted PBI-023 change (worktree C:/Users/jdk/dispatch-board-worktrees/PBI-023, branch pbi/PBI-023-pr-links). CR-PBI023-01: gh pr list must return the 20 most recently updated PRs. CR-PBI023-02: page checks must catch a guard that drops the trailing slash of https://github.com/. CR-PBI023-03: a PR state named like an inherited object member must not crash the GitHub tab. Grounding: ran-suite (python unittest + node page harness; gh faked, never called).
report.summary: 5 files modified (exporters/export_board.py, site/index.html, CLAUDE.md, tests/test_export_board.py, tests/page.test.mjs); 2 page checks added, GH_ARGS updated. python -m unittest discover -s tests: 215 ran, OK. node tests/page.test.mjs: 57 passed, 0 failed (was 55). Mutation (startsWith without trailing slash) on a scratch copy: 55 ok then fails on the lookalike-host check, exit 1; copy deleted. refresh.py not run, out/ untouched, real gh never called. Nothing committed, staged, pushed or deployed.

changes.why: CR-PBI023-01: PR_LIST adds --search sort:updated-desc so gh picks the 20 most recently updated PRs, not the 20 newest; comments restated; client-side sort kept as a safety net
CR-PBI023-01: GH_ARGS expects the sort qualifier
CR-PBI023-01: projectTabs git row gives the new gh command and says it returns the 20 most recently updated PRs; notes that an unknown state shows as a neutral tag
CR-PBI023-03: prRow looks up prState with Object.hasOwn and falls back to the muted tag with the escaped raw state
CR-PBI023-02 and -03: lookalike-host / http / userinfo check and inherited-key state check

tests.covers: PullRequests.test_pulls_come_from_gh_in_the_repo_most_recently_updated_first asserts the exact gh argv incl. --search sort:updated-desc (red before the fix)
pulls: lookalike hosts, plain http and userinfo tricks are text, not links, in the panel and in Needs attention
pulls: an unknown state, even one named like an inherited object member, is a muted tag with the escaped raw state (red before the fix: TypeError function is not iterable)

acceptance.criterion: AC1: PR_LIST passes --search sort:updated-desc; GH_ARGS, the pulls() comment and the CLAUDE.md row match; client-side sort kept
acceptance.evidence: test_export_board failed on the argv diff before the fix and passes after; full Python suite 215 OK

acceptance.criterion: AC2: PRs with urls https://github.com.evil.example/o/r/pull/1, http://github.com/o/r/pull/2, https://github.com@evil.example/x render as text with no href in the GitHub panel and in Needs attention; the trailing-slash mutation now fails the suite
acceptance.evidence: new check passes on site/index.html; on the scratch mutant (diff --strip-trailing-cr shows only line 278 changed) the suite exits 1 at that check after 55 ok; mutant was 55/55 green before the check existed

acceptance.criterion: AC3: a PR state of constructor, __proto__, toString or hasOwnProperty (or HTML) renders a muted tag with the escaped raw state, the tab renders, and nothing is logged to console.error
acceptance.evidence: new check failed with 'unexpected console.error ... TypeError: function is not iterable' before the fix; passes after, with noPageErrors asserted; 57/57 page checks

follow_ups.reason: Re-review the three fixes for GO.

Outside this change: stateLabel[x.state] || x.state (Backlog) and similar lookups also read plain objects by data key. They do not crash, since esc() stringifies the result, but an inherited name would show function text. Worth a separate check.
